title: Defining No Ship Days

children:
"No ship days" indicate when a carrier cannot transport product. 
 You can define no ship days that prohibit shipping on a weekend day (Saturday 
 or Sunday). You can also define unique no ship days which occur only once 
 during the calendar year, such as holidays. Later, you will associate 
 shipping calendar records with the appropriate carriers. When the system calculates the days to deliver for a shipment, it references 
 the carrier's shipping calendar record. If shipment is to be shipped on 
 a no ship date, it will be manifested on the next valid shipping date. 
 If the carrier has a no ship day between today and the shipment's delivery 
 date, the system will adjust the delivery date to account for the no ship 
 date. For example, suppose your warehouse does not ship product on July 
 4th because you are closed for the holiday, and today is July 3rd. Shipment 
 AAAA requires 
 5 shipping days to reach its destination. When the system calculated the 
 ship date for Shipment AAAA 
 it would assume that 6 shipping days are required (not 5 days), since 
 it cannot ship on July 4th. Therefore, the calculated shipping date would 
 be July 8th, not July 7th.

NOTE: If a carrier is not tied 
 to a shipping calendar, then the system will assume that this carrier 
 does not ship on Saturday or Sunday.

Before you begin, provide the record's name and description. Select 
 the Apply Button. You can now address the values on the Weekend Tab.

You can use this tab to identify no ship weekend days. If you identify 
 either Saturday or Sunday as a no ship day, the system will assume that 
 carriers associated with this calendar never 
 ship on the excluded day(s). 
 This tab includes the following checkboxes: 
 the Exclude All Saturdays Checkbox and the Exclude All Sundays Checkbox. 
 Both of these checkboxes 
 are preselected 
 for you. If you leave them both checked, any carrier associated with this 
 calendar will not ship product on either Saturday or Sunday. When the 
 system calculates the days to deliver for the carrier (associated with 
 this calendar), it factors in these no ship days.

You can use the Holidays Tab to identify specific days that a carrier 
 does not ship product.

Use the Date Field to select 
 the appropriate date from this calendar. The system will display it in 
 the records list.

Use the Description Field 
 to identify the holiday.

Select the Apply to All Calendars 
 Checkbox if you want to associate this no ship date with   all shipping calendars. Generally, 
 you will only select this value if your warehouse is closed on this date.

Press Apply. The system 
 will activate the data grid.

Select the Add 
 Button. The system will display the no ship date in the data grid. 
 Create additional records if necessary.
